svg.title: Northwest Community College - historical full-colour logo
svg.desc: Original vector artwork extracted from CMTN Connection, Spring 2025 50th Anniversary Magazine, PDF page 4, printed page 6. Source: https://www.coastmountaincollege.ca/docs/default-source/about/publications/2025-cmtn-connection-magazine_spread-min.pdf. Original path geometry, placement, fills and clipping retained; no tracing or font substitution.
